title: Card Extension of the Complimentary Alterations Window — Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Q&A
content:
Holders of Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards receive a card window extension, added to the Marlowe & Finch Alterations complimentary window counted from a purchase's completed date:

| The customer's cards and the purchase | Card window extension |
|---|---|
| The purchase was charged to the customer's Marlowe & Finch card account, and that account is active today | 15 calendar days |
| The customer holds an active Marlowe & Finch card account, but the purchase was not charged to it | 5 calendar days |
| The customer holds no active Marlowe & Finch card account | none |

**Records read.** The card account recorded on the Merchandise Purchases record the ticket names (the account the purchase was charged to), and the status today of each of the customer's Marlowe & Finch card accounts.

## Questions answered by the rule

**The purchase was charged to a Store Card that has since been closed, and the customer holds an active Platinum Mastercard.** The account charged is not active today; the customer holds an active account the purchase was not charged to: 5 calendar days.

**The purchase was charged to a Store Card that has since been closed, and no other account is held.** No active account: none.

**The purchase was paid in cash, and the customer holds an active Store Card Elite.** An active account is held, but the purchase was not charged to it: 5 calendar days.

**The purchase was charged to the customer's active World Elite Mastercard.** 15 calendar days.
